mechanism_of_action: Anti-inflammatory role; the source suggests improved inflammatory cytokine levels may contribute to anti-steatotic effects.
efficacy_outcome: After 8 weeks, curcuminoids improved ultrasound-assessed NAFLD severity (p=0.002) and reduced weight versus placebo (p=0.016); TNF-alpha (p=0.024), MCP-1 (p=0.008), and EGF (p=0.0001) also improved.
